name: venture-platform
description: Home-services bidding marketplace — Mainframe / Centcom / Workers / Customer / CIC

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup && npm run seed
scripts.db:setup: npm --workspace @vp/mainframe run db:push && npm --workspace @vp/mainframe run generate
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace @vp/cic run build && npm --workspace @vp/centcom-ui run build
scripts.start: npm run db:setup && npm run seed:boot && npm run build:apps && npm run serve
